# BludWear — Brand & Product Knowledge File

Uncompromising luxury athleisure and heavyweight streetwear engineered for high performance, deep movement, and modern urban aesthetics. Forged in blood and sweat.

## Active Promotions & Offers
- **Buy ₹799+ Get ₹599 Free (B1G1 Offer)**: Purchasing any item priced ₹799 or more qualifies the customer for a FREE ₹599 garment in their cart. Discount applies automatically at checkout.
- **Free Pan-India Shipping**: Free shipping on all orders over ₹999 across India.
- **Kit Bundles**: Buying matching Top + Bottom outfit sets grants an automatic 15% bundle discount.

## Core Product Categories & Technical Specifications
- **Heavyweight Streetwear**: Oversized t-shirts and fleece hoodies crafted from 240 GSM to 400 GSM heavy combed cotton.
- **Compression Performance Wear**: Muscle-stabilizing leggings, tights, and tops with reinforced flatlock stitching and quick-dry moisture-wicking technology.
- **Bottoms**: Elite athletic shorts, drop-crotch track bottoms, and tapered performance joggers.
- **Tops & Outerwear**: Drop-shoulder athletic tees, training tanks, and heavy fleece hoodies.

## Sizing & Fit Guidelines
- **Compression Gear**: Form-fitting athletic compression designed for muscle support. Size up for a relaxed fit.
- **Streetwear Tees & Hoodies**: True-to-size drop-shoulder athletic silhouette.
- **Men's Chest Sizes**: S (36-38"), M (38-40"), L (40-42"), XL (42-44"), XXL (44-46").
- **Women's Bust Sizes**: S (32-34", UK 6-8), M (34-36", UK 10-12), L (36-38", UK 14), XL (38-40", UK 16).

## Customer Policies & Operations
- **Geo-Service Area**: Servicing all states and pin codes across India with live Shiprocket express shipping.
- **Dispatch**: Fast 24-hour dispatch with automated tracking link generation.
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 14-day hassle-free return and exchange policy initiated directly from the user orders portal.
- **Payment Options**: Instant UPI / QR code payments, Credit/Debit cards, Netbanking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Official Contact**: Customer support email at wearblud@gmail.com and live inquiry form at `/contact-us`.
